dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored perimeters exhibit irregular, jagged outer boundaries with a sharp high-contrast transition from the dark background. The rings vary from closed elliptical loops in the posterior region to interconnected, semi-open curvilinear structures in the mid-dorsal section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity clusters distributed across the mid-lateral and anterior neck regions. These clusters lack internal dark cores and appear as discrete, high-luminance pixel groupings approximately 4-12 pixels in diameter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent isosceles triangular relationship is formed by the centroids of three large annuli in the posterior quadrant. A secondary cluster of four high-intensity blobs forms a trapezoidal geometric arrangement in the mid-ventral field.
